subtasks.objective: Harden POS print update and realtime print publish endpoints so callers can only mark or print POS invoices they are authorized to access in their branch.
subtasks.acceptance: qz_print_update(invoice) and print_pos_page(...) both load the target POS Invoice, enforce document-level permission, and reject cross-branch access before mutating invoice_printed, releasing tables, or publishing realtime print jobs; existing legitimate same-branch POS printing continues to work.
